title: 4/15 02:00 reconcile rewrote the local streak to 0: the backward walk broke on the pre-generated preview pick file
tier_reason: local streak state was overwritten with a wrong value (state impact); the today-exclusion the fix introduced is still in the replay at HEAD and is the root of the unfixed same-day rollback (L02), which can still change local state

contract.text: Reconciliation recomputes the local streak from resolved pick results only; an unplayed pick (result None) is 'not played', not a miss, and must not end the walk.
contract.source: commit 1d61908 message body; src/bts/picks.py reconcile_results comment 'Always recalculate streak from scratch'

mechanism.text: reconcile_results recomputed the streak by walking every *.json in the picks dir newest-first, skipping only streak/automation; any other file whose result was not hit/miss ended the walk. The 03:00 chain's `bts preview` pre-writes the next UTC day's pick file (result None), so at 02:00 the newest file was that day's unplayed preview, the walk broke at once and save_streak(0) ran. *.shadow.json files (always result None) could break the walk the same way.

residual.text: The fix skips every pick file dated today or later. The same `f.stem >= today_iso` exclusion survives in _replay_season_streak at HEAD, so a reconcile run later on the same day drops today's already-applied terminal result and can roll back the streak and saver (the same-day replay rollback, L02, a pre-existing defect).

watchdog.trigger: after every write to streak.json (01:00 check-results, 02:00 reconcile, scheduler result polling), the persisted streak is lower than its previous value although no pick file gained a new terminal miss since that value was written, or it differs from a forward replay of resolved pick files through yesterday
watchdog.recovery_assertion: after the next grading run, streak.json (and saver) equal the forward replay of resolved picks (and, once contest state exists, the contest-reported streak)

evidence.what: symptom observed 2026-04-15: streak.json was rewritten to 0 at 02:00 ET by the reconcile cron when the previous day's double-down result should have left it at 2; the walk hit today's pre-generated preview pick (result None); the body says this reset happened 'every night'
the walk iterates reversed(sorted(picks_dir.glob('*.json'))), skips only stems streak/automation, and breaks on any result other than hit/miss, then calls save_streak(streak)
preview defaults its date to UTC now + 1 day and runs in the 03:00 chain; reconcile runs at 02:00, so the next night's walk starts at an unplayed preview file
push-to-main deploy of head 1d61908 created 2026-04-15T16:05:33Z, conclusion success; log unavailable_expired
first retained deploy log: pre-deploy SHA eaccaf8 (a descendant of 1d61908) already installed at 2026-06-07T00:11:19Z
a daytime or 23:00 reconcile still rolls local streak state back before today's already-scored result because the replay excludes today's file; flagged as a pre-existing defect

notes: the incident is about the streak value itself, so ev1 restates it with exposure row X-01; the batters named in the body are not repeated

'every night' (ev1): earlier nightly resets since the preview command (0729031, 4/10) and the Hetzner cron (d5c466c, 4/12) are plausible but not separately evidenced; streak.json is overwritten, so only the 4/15 occurrence is recorded
policy_objective reach57: the scheduler's select_pick read load_streak(), so the 4/15 reach-57 decision may have used the reset value (code inference; the 4/15 pick file is Route R material)
first_machine_detection none: no health checks existed until 4/28 (e74c485); the operator found it
mitigation unknown: whether streak.json was hand-corrected on 4/15 or only by the next 02:00 run after the fix deploy is not recorded
